title: Runway Scenarios & OKR Mapping for Q3 Hosted Endpoints + Model Fleet
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Purpose: Produce a validated quarterly runway and OKR mapping for Q3 that governs hosted endpoints and the model fleet. Scope includes demand scenario planning, capacity commitments, model onboarding gating, rollout/canary schedule, and cost/regression guardrails.

Goals and deliverables:
- 3 demand scenarios (Conservative / Expected / High-peak) with capacity and cost estimates per scenario.
- Prioritized initiative list that maps to top-level OKRs and owner assignments.
- Model onboarding gating checklist (eval thresholds, perf regressions, safety flags, quantization profile).
- Canary & rollback calendar for staged releases across regions and Dedicated pools.
- Runbook snippets for graceful degradation: model variant fallback rules, cross-region routing, and throttling thresholds.
- Success metric definitions and dashboards to track progress (p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, model-accuracy regression rate, rollout error rate).

Key considerations and constraints:
- Need alignment with Dedicated capacity sales commitments and pre-reserved pools.
- Avoid schedule conflicts with major runtime-1.22 kernel changes planned in March.
- Ensure the Console team has per-route observability hooks for any staged rollouts.

Acceptance criteria:
- Signed-off initiative list and canary calendar from Eng, Console, Reliability, and Sales.
- Updated hostedapi-2025.03 release plan with capacity and cost estimates attached.
- Confluence runway playbook published and linked from the product roadmap board.

Notes on differences from prior quarters: focus on model-health gating (new automated eval thresholds) and tighter coupling between cost optimizations (quantization/batching) and quality SLOs.
success_metrics: p95_latency_ms <= 200 across 95% routes; cost_per_1M_tokens <= $18; rollout_error_rate < 1% during canaries; model_regression_alerts <= 2/week
